title: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16
description: A HuCard image: a copier header (if any) as data, then each 8 KB bank one ca65 segment linked at the page the code that maps it expects (flow tracks the MPRs: console_pce.cpp), the ten vector bytes at the end of bank 0. The chips' registers by their hardware names, the zero page as zp_nn; an ld65 configuration lays the segments out in file order.

machine.toolchain: CodeBreaker's own assembler (ca65 syntax), or cc65 (ca65 and ld65)
